environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.xlarge) in us-east-1 VPC running the legacy monolith. Instance has IAM role 'legacy-monolith-prod' with S3, DynamoDB, and SES permissions. IMDSv1 enabled (default). Security group allows inbound 443 from ALB and outbound 0.0.0.0/0 on all ports. CloudHSM cluster in same VPC subnet for signing operations. No network-level restriction on metadata service access from application layer.
